Revenue 1.00 less the printed cost of sales 0.20 equals the printed gross profit 0.80. Gross profit less the printed administration expenses 32.23 equals the printed loss from operating activities 31.43, which is also the printed loss before tax and the printed loss for the period because the filing charged no tax and reports no finance cost. Printed loss on continuing operations (62.96) for 2025 and (86.33) for 2024; profit attributable to the group (58.92) and (79.35). Ties: the stored Profit before tax of (49.78) and (73.15) less the stored tax expense of 13.18 and 13.19 equals (62.96) and (86.33). Guards: no fill where cost of sales is negative, no fill producing a non-positive revenue. Each value is read from the printed statement named in repairs, not derived. | CRON 20261116: Net Profit written for 4 years as Profit Before Tax less Income Tax, corroborated by the stored EPS. | 20261116_010142: 2 cell(s) derived from the file own rows, identity confirmed on every other populated period | CRON 20261118: FY2025 Revenue verified as printed NIL, not a collection gap. The audited consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the year ended 31 December 2025, printed page 18 of the NGX filing, shows REVENUE of a single dash for 2025 against 1.00 million naira for 2024, and the five year consolidated financial summary on printed page 45 prints TURNOVER of a dash for 2025 against 1.00 for 2024. Cost of sales is a dash in every column, so gross profit is nil as well. The stored blank stays blank because a dash is the filer's own nil and writing a zero would present a measured figure the statement does not print. | Net Finance Costs set to 0 for FY2025 and FY2024: the audited statement of profit or loss prints FINANCE COST as nil in both years (FY2025 annual report p20). | CRON 20261120_065041: blank Net Profit cell filled by arithmetic on this file own printed rows under an identity that holds in EVERY other populated period (3 agreements, 0 contradictions); no new figure collected. | CRON 20261120_065041: blank Net Profit cell filled by arithmetic on this file own printed rows under an identity that holds in EVERY other populated period (3 agreements, 0 contradictions); no new figure collected. | CRON 20261120_065041: blank Revenue cell filled by arithmetic on this file own printed rows under an identity that holds in EVERY other populated period (4 agreements, 0 contradictions); no new figure collected.
